name: Verify cancelling publication via "Ні" button closes pop-up and keeps "Опублікувати" enabled
description:
As an administrator of the Victory Center admin panel,
  I want to view, validate, and manage content in the "Хто ми" section,
  So that information across all blocks is accurate, validated, and safely published.

steps.name: Given the administrator is logged in
And the admin navigates to the "Хто ми" page
Open Admin 'Хто ми' page
Wait until Admin 'Хто ми' page is loaded
When the admin selects the "Основне" tab
Select tab: Основне
Select category tab: Основне
Check if category tab 'Основне' is selected
Get selected category tab text
And the admin modifies card 1 with valid text "Новий валідний опис основного"
Set description text: Новий валідний опис основного
Trigger blur on description editor
And the admin clicks the "Опублікувати" button
Click 'Опублікувати' button
And the admin clicks "Ні" in the confirmation pop-up
Decline the pending action
Then the publish confirmation pop-up is closed
Check if confirmation modal is closed
And the "Опублікувати" button is enabled
Check if 'Опублікувати' button is enabled
